messages:
Priya S: Hi finance — today at LAX my flight got delayed 4.5h and I bought access + a $45 food voucher at the airline lounge. The corporate card shows the lounge vendor charge AND a pending ‘LoungeVoucher Redemption 45.00 USD’ on my personal card (I used personal because the lounge kiosk only accepted debit). Can this be reconciled or reimbursed? I uploaded receipt and voucher screenshot to Concur.

Finance Bot: Automated: please add the lounge receipt and the voucher code to your Concur claim. Policy note: "airport lounge vouchers are reimbursable when delay >3 hours or overnight due to carrier issues." See: https://intra.redwood/expenses#delays :information_source:

Priya S: Voucher code on screenshot: LV-3321-AX. Screenshot filename `priya-lounge-voucher.png`. Receipt text snippet: 
```
Airline Lounge - LAX
Food voucher #LV-3321-AX
Amount: USD 45.00
Date: 2026-03-08
Merchant ref: AL-LAX-7783
```
Charged to personal Chase (ending 1287). Card statement shows vendor charge CC-TXN-6110 that matches the lounge kiosk charge.

Marco D: Approved — client meeting got delayed and she was stuck at the airport. Please reimburse.

Finance Bot: Next steps: confirm manager approval in Concur, set category `Travel - Delay / Food`, and choose ACH to last4 1287. Processing ETA 2 payroll cycles.

Elena R: Logging as exception EX-2026-016. I'll open a chargeback for the corpcard duplicate (ticket CB-90) and mark the personal claim for reimbursement once Concur finishes. Priya, what's the project code?

Priya S: Charge to project `CS-MAIN-09` (client: Bexley).

People Ops: Noted — we should clarify the policy about kiosk-only vendors that force personal charges. Adding to the expense policy update doc. :pencil2:

Finance Bot: Reimbursement queued (queue id: RQ-7791). Corpcard duplicate flagged. Will notify when ACH posts.

Elena R: Got it, processing now. Will follow up if finance needs the kiosk's merchant GPS or additional proof. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
